build_encoder_subclass: build a python module that subclasses FairseqEncoder and implements forward and reorder_encoder_out methods
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass on src_tokens through a FairseqEncoder subclass to get encoder output
create_encoder_out_namedtuple: create an EncoderOut NamedTuple with encoder_out tensor, padding mask, and source tokens
reorder_encoder_output: reorder encoder output tensors according to a new batch order using reorder_encoder_out
upgrade_state_dict: upgrade an old model state dict to work with newer FairseqEncoder code using upgrade_state_dict_named
